name: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
desc: Bell pepper halves filled with lean ground turkey, brown rice, corn and tomatoes, baked under mozzarella and Parmesan.

source.title: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 4 large bell peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded
1 lb 93% lean ground turkey (or lean ground beef)
1 cup cooked brown rice or quinoa
1/2 cup corn kernels (frozen and thawed, or canned and drained)
ingredients.note: frozen and thawed, or canned and drained

steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains, 5-7 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until soft, 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the rice, corn, tomatoes, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt and pepper and cook 2-3 minutes.
Set the pepper halves cut side up in a 9x13 in baking dish and pack them with the filling. Top with the mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 10-15 minutes more, until the peppers are tender and the cheese is golden.
tips: 4 servings of 2 halves each, about 520 cal per serving.
Skinnytaste pours a little broth into the bottom of the dish before baking covered, which steams the peppers more tender; add 1/4 cup water or broth if you like softer peppers.

references.title: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
references.usedFor: 9x13 dish, foil-covered bake, liquid in the pan for tender peppers, oil for browning lean turkey
